body: The raw error text of a failed keep still reaches members: GET refs/{id}/keep and the keep map of PUT saved-albums return work_item.error as 'reason' to anyone (it can hold exception class names and paths). POST /keep/progress no longer does. Fix as its own PR before the app parts: send failed reasons through keeper/failures.describe_failure with host from the role, and never send raw text for queued items to members. The app does not read 'reason', so nothing breaks.
